shots.say: Can Little Crab find a shell that fits? Look! His shell is much too small!
shots.tag: hook: the shell is too small

shots.say: The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! Down in the shallow water lives my friend, Little Crab.
shots.tag: shore wide: Milo on his rock

shots.say: I grew, and I grew! Now my shell is too tight. I can hardly wiggle!
shots.tag: Little Crab: my shell is too tight

shots.say: Hermit crabs live in empty snail shells. The shell is their house!
shots.tag: fact: hermit crabs live in empty snail shells

shots.say: Where does a hermit crab live? In a shell, or in a nest?
As a hermit crab grows, it must find a bigger shell, and move in.
shots.tag: fact: a growing hermit crab needs a bigger shell

shots.say: What does a growing hermit crab need? A bigger shell, or a hat?
Good morning, Little Crab! Why do you wiggle so?
I need a new house, Tula. A shell that fits just right!
shots.tag: Little Crab: I need a new house

shots.say: Then let's go and look for one. I will come with you!
shots.tag: Tula: I will come with you

shots.say: Find a shell that is not too big, and not too small. A shell that fits just right!
First, they find a great big shell. Wow! It is huge!
So much room! I will try it on.
Little Crab climbs in. But where did he go? The shell is much too big!
Hello? It is wobbly in here. I slide all around!
shots.tag: Little Crab: I slide all around

shots.say: Is the huge shell just right? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: huge shell yes or no

shots.say: Next, a shiny shell sits by the big rocks. It is thick, and very pretty.
shots.tag: the shiny shell by the rocks

shots.say: Ooh, shiny! And this one is just my size.
Little Crab pulls, and pulls. But the shell will not move. It is much too heavy!
Phew! I cannot carry this house.
shots.tag: Little Crab: I cannot carry it

shots.say: Why can't Little Crab take the shiny shell? Too heavy, or too small?
shots.tag: question: too heavy or too small

shots.say: Can you pull, like Little Crab? Pull, pull, pull!
Then, under the green kelp, they see a shell that looks just right.
Knock, knock! Is anybody home?
Two little eyes peek out. A snail lives in this shell!
Oh! Sorry, Snail. This house is yours.
shots.tag: Little Crab: this house is yours

shots.say: Can Little Crab take the snail's shell? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: the snail's shell yes or no

shots.say: Three shells, and not one is right. Little Crab sits down on the sand.
Too big. Too heavy. And somebody is home. Maybe there is no shell for me.
shots.tag: Little Crab: maybe there is no shell for me

shots.say: How does Little Crab feel now? Sad, or happy?
Then Little Crab looks at his two claws. And he has an idea!
Now I know what I need! Not too big, not too heavy, and empty.
shots.tag: Little Crab: I know what I need

shots.say: Tula, you can dive deep! Will you bring me shells? I will try them, one by one.
Down, down, down goes Tula, into the deep blue water. So many empty shells!
This one, and this one, and this one. Little Crab can try them all!
The back part of a hermit crab's body is soft. It fits inside the shell.
shots.tag: fact: the soft back part fits inside the shell

shots.say: Which part of a hermit crab is soft? The back part, or the claws?
Tula comes back with shells for Little Crab. Let's count them! One, two, three!
Let me check with my claws. Tap, tap, tap.
The white shell? Too small. The red shell? Too big.
And the golden shell? Little Crab slips inside.
shots.tag: he slips into the golden shell

shots.say: It fits! It fits just right!
Hooray! The golden shell is not too big, not too heavy, and it is empty.
shots.tag: the golden shell is just right

shots.say: Which shell fits just right? The golden shell, or the white shell?
Not too big, and not too small. My new house is best of all!
Did Little Crab find a shell that fits? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: did he find a shell yes or no

shots.say: The sun goes down, and the water turns gold. Little Crab is cozy in his new house.
Thank you, Tula! You carried every shell.
And you knew just what you needed. Clever Little Crab!
I love my new house. I can wiggle, and wiggle, and wiggle!
And look at the old blue shell. A tiny crab moves in. Now it is her house!
shots.tag: a tiny crab moves into the old shell

shots.say: When something does not fit, try again. One by one, you will find what is just right.
Do you remember? Where do hermit crabs live? In empty shells, or in trees?
And when a hermit crab grows, what does it find? A bigger shell, or a smaller shell?
Not too big, and not too small. A cozy house is best of all!
Next time: Poppy and the Dancing Sky! See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
